$comment: Admin file for the public demo deployment (rg-claude-gw-public-demo, no network restriction, Foundry from the <foundry-subscription> subscription's <foundry-account> account). node scripts/admin/new-gateway-config.mjs --topology test --admin config/gateway-admin.azure-test-demo.json --out config/gateway.azure-test-demo.yaml renders it. roles: the app roles in infra/azure-test/entra-app.json that the gateway admits. models: <foundry-account>' own deployment names, which differ from the usual ai-contosohub ones (claude-opus-5-5, not claude-opus-5). deployment.adminApi: true turns on the spend-limits admin API (ADR-0008) for admin-ui.
